narrative: Two employees were fighting when one of them threw hot grease on the other. The second employee suffered second- and third-degree burns and was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering steel from a truck that was not on level ground. He was untying the tie-down strap when a piece of steel pipe rolled off of the truck and broke his lower right leg.

An employee was assembling a shelf with a nail gun containing 18-gauge, 3/4-inch nails. While placing together two pieces, he lost grip of the pieces and the nail gun fired into the palm of his left hand.

An employee was mixing a solution of caustic soda and water in a large tank/container when the solution splashed onto him. The employee sustained first-degree chemical burns to his face, arms, and legs.
An employee was cleaning an area when her glove was caught by a chain and sprocket behind a conveyor. Her right thumb was pulled in and the thumb tip was amputated.

Employees were setting coping on a wall with an excavator. The excavator pulled on a piece of coping (weighing 800-1000 pounds) and caused it to tip over. It fell onto an employee's lower legs; the employee suffered a broken hip and was hospitalized.

While entering his tractor trailer on the driver's side, an employee felt a pop in his lower back. He did not slip or fall. After driving for one hour, the driver's seat came out of locked position and he sustained pain in the lower back.

An employee carrying a tote walked up to the large trash compactor to dump the tote contents. A coworker rolled up a pallet jack carrying a large box to the compactor and struck the employee, pushing him into the trash compactor. The employee's right upper leg broke, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was working in the kitchen when fingers on his right hand were amputated by a grinder.
An employee was outside, washing out a trash can using a water hose. As she walked away, her foot was stuck in a hole in the ground and she fell, breaking her left ankle.
An employee was mixing caustic soda in a mixing barrel when it reacted and splashed on him, causing chemical burns to his right and left wrists, left bicep, and both knees.
An employee was placing roofing supplies on a roof when he lost his footing and slid approximately 12 feet off the roof to the ground, dislocating his right ankle.
An employee was cleaning a machine area when the machine caught the employee's pant leg, causing a fracture that resulted in surgical amputation of the leg.

An employee was driving a truck to a work station. She was turning a corner when the truck's back wheel went over the bank, rolling the vehicle. When the truck rolled, her left hand went out of the window and was smashed.
An employee was removing finished material from the machine when he tripped on the hoist hook on the floor. He broke his right hip.

An employee was wearing work gloves while operating a vertical milling machine to fabricate a tube. The employee attempted to adjust the tube in the machine with his left hand when his work glove got caught on a set screw. His left little fingertip was amputated; there was no bone loss.

An employee opened the trailer door of a truck that had just arrived. A double-stacked pallet inside the truck had become unstable, and its weight pushed the door open very quickly. The employee was knocked to the floor between the truck and the dock plate; the pallet then fell from the trailer onto the employee's right knee. The employee suffered a broken right tibia.
An employee was working on a pump when material that was 45% potassium hydroxide sprayed out and contacted his face.
An employee's left index finger was caught in the door hinges while opening the door from the main office to the factory area resulting in amputation.
An employee was cleaning out the dust collector for a milling machine and sustained amputations to their right middle and ring fingers. The machine was running at the time.
An employee was training a new coworker on cutting PVC pipe when the saw blade amputated the employee's left index finger just below the first knuckle. The saw was guarded at the time.
An employee was walking through the deli kitchen area when they tripped and fell into the corner of a table and landed on the floor. The employee sustained a broken nose and a concussion.
An employee was on an A-frame ladder, installing the header of a window frame. The employee fell to the ground about 5 feet below and suffered broken ribs and a broken wrist.
An employee was using a table saw and cut the tip of his finger.

On Tuesday, February 16, 2017, at approximately 12:30PM, an employee was in the process of washing out the salt spreader on the rear of a truck. The employee sustained fractures to his right arm and was hospitalized when his hand was caught in the moving spreader mechanism.
An employee was checking in a vendor when she fell to the floor causing tooth fragments to become lodged into her lip and resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was stepping off a ladder, tripped over a copper AC line, and dislocated an ankle.
An employee was riding a horse in the feedlot and fell to the ground. He required surgery to repair the damage to his pelvis.

Two employees were in an elevated aerial lift and had just finished installing a sign onto a warehouse building. As the lift swung away from the building, it contacted overhead power lines that were 45 feet away from the base of the lift. One employee experienced electrical shock and burns to 27% of his body (arms, hands and back) and was hospitalized. The second employee was treated and released.
An employee had just set a concrete panel on a bridge deck when he fell from the edge of the deck to the compacted ground 13-14 feet below. He suffered fractured ribs and vertebrae.
An employee was helping another employee lift a box when the weight shifted in the box and he felt a pinch in his back. He was hospitalized with a lower back strain.

An employee was exiting the main door on the east side of the building when he was struck by a powered-industrial vehicle carrying two metal tubs weighing about 500 pounds each. The employee sustained a left thumb, right shoulder, and left knee injury.

The employee was walking back to the office after collecting mail when a U-Haul employee, who was servicing a truck, backed it up and ran over the injured employee. The back wheels ran over the employee's abdomen severely injuring him.
An employee was operating a table saw when his left hand contacted the blade, amputating three fingertips to the first knuckle.
An employee was injured while guiding a buggy cart that was coming down a ramp. The buggy cart got away and struck his leg. The employee was hospitalized for a fractured leg.

An employee was operating the trimmer when a piece of wood/board became stuck. The employee went to remove the board and their hand was caught in the chain and sprocket, amputating the employee's right index fingertip and the right thumb tip.

An employee was standing on their flatbed truck adjusting a cargo pallet. He pulled one of the pallet boards and the board broke, causing the employee to lose his balance and jump 4 feet off the flatbed. The employee landed on a concrete surface and sustained a fractured left heel that required surgery.
Employee was working on a can wrench without the lock out/tag out system in place. The jaws of the machine opened and retracted smashing and amputating the tip of the middle finger on his left hand.

An employee was dispatched to a parts distributor to pick up parts. The employee was standing by the loading dock. While doing so, a truck backed up to the dock and pinned the employee against the dock.

An employee was transporting sulfuric acid in a plastic bucket when the bucket handle failed and the bucket tipped. The corrosive acid contacted the employee's legs, causing third degree chemical burns to the legs and feet.

A cowboy was walking his horse out of the horse barn to start the day. When he climbed on his horse it started to buck and he fell to the ground. He sustained fractured ribs and vertebrae, and a punctured lung.
An employee was cutting meat with a band saw while using a push plate when the saw cut her right index finger. Her fingertip was amputated.

An employee was using a stand-up forklift to move palletized product. While pulling the forks out from beneath a pallet, the employee suffered two broken fingers on the left hand when the hand was caught between a warehouse rack and the forklift's outside roll cage.
An employee was assisting in transferring a patient from the bed to their wheelchair. Upon lifting the patient, the employee sustained a cervical fracture.

An employee was stacking wood about 28 feet from a rip saw when a piece of wood was thrown from the rip saw and struck the employee in the back. The wood impaled his back and went through his stomach.
An employee was kicked by horse resulting in fractures to the jaw requiring surgery.

An employee was working at the capping station on a bottling line when some caps fell off the automated capper onto the moving conveyor belt and were caught under the guard. The employee was attempting to retrieve the caps when her right ring fingertip was amputated.

An employee was operating an electric pallet jack to transport pallets of food when the employee was caught between the pallet jack and a metal warehouse rack post. The employee sustained lacerations to his left leg near the knee.

The employee was installing plastic electrical conduit onsite. The circuit was energized from a 7200 volt transformer located near the sidewalk. When the employee attempted to connect the conduit to the transformer, his right bicep contacted the transformer. The employee was on his knees when he received the electrical shock and he fell backwards and/or collapsed. He was admitted to the hospital on 5/28/2015 at or around 4:30 p.m. and treated for burns received from the electrical shock.

An employee was using a dismantler to pull the boards of a pallet apart. His hand became caught in the pallet, and he was unable to remove his hand before the pallet went through the blade of the dismantler. His pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee was installing a spring on a 3x5 door when the spring popped off and struck the employee on left side of head.

On August 1, 2023, an employee was walking across a roof to get safety equipment when they slipped and fell through a skylight. The employee fell approximately five and a half feet onto a metal catwalk and then approximately 10 feet to the floor below, resulting in a shoulder injury and a laceration to the head. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was cutting a circular pattern in cloth using an electric rotary cutter. The cloth got caught in the cutting tool's blade and the employee's hand was pulled into the tool. The employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
An employee was walking across a crosswalk in a breast deboning department with a knife in his hand. He lost his balance and the knife punctured his chest and lung.
Two employees were working and got into an altercation. One employee struck the other with a 2x4 causing head and back injuries.

On Friday, May 12, 2017, at approximately 10:00 p.m., an employee of the restaurant was walking out of the manager's office when his right little finger was caught in the doorframe on the hinge side, amputating the soft tissue of the right little fingertip.

On September 28, 2018, at 8:00 a.m. two employees were working together to install an exhaust pipe on the rear engine compartment of airport-sized snow removal equipment. The injured employee was working from an attached catwalk on the snow removal equipment to install the exhaust pipe while the other employee was on the roof of the equipment to hold the top of the pipe and secure a bolt. While installing the exhaust pipe, the injured employee stepped back and fell approximately 59 inches landing on the concrete floor below. He was hospitalized for a severe concussion, broken vertebrae in the neck and a shoulder injury.
An employee fell approximately 10 feet while attempting to descend from the top of an office (mezzanine) that is located inside an aircraft hangar. He was hospitalized with two broken wrists.

An employee was unrolling waterproof conduit on a roof. He tripped over a fall protection anchor installed in the roof and fell backwards onto a 3-inch plumbing vent pipe that extended 14 inches above the roof. He suffered several cracked ribs.
After turning on an air compressor, an employee was descending a ladder when it slipped out and the employee fell approximately 5 feet, suffering a broken right ankle.

The injured employee was loading cardboard material into a machine. A forklift that had a lifted stack of cardboard on it was nearby. The stack fell over a barrier and onto the employee. The employee was knocked to the ground and sustained a hip fracture.
An employee was using a hand grinder to eliminate discrepancies on columns around the project when the grinder jumped and came out of the employee's hands. They sustained a little finger amputation.
An employee was clearing out an 8" pelletizer. The employee's hand got caught in the pelletizer resulting in the amputation of the thumb and index finger. The machine was not locked out at the time.
An employee was using a pipe wrench to tighten a fitting when the wrench amputated his little finger.
An employee was operating a brake press. The press activated and severed four fingers on the employee's right hand.
While climbing a hill, an employee collapsed and suffered a heart attack.
An employee was operating a stand-up forklift in the warehouse when the forklift spun and the employee was caught between the forklift and metal shelving. The employee sustained multiple broken ribs.
A driver was opening the back door of a trailer when product fell and broke their left ankle.

An employee was directing a roll-off container truck to reverse into position for dumping demolition debris when a grapple loader nearby reversed and pinned the employee's right arm against the side of the roll-off container truck. The employee's right arm was crushed.

An employee was adjusting a printing plate and got his hand caught in a pinch point between two rollers when another employee jogged the machine using the registration button. The employee suffered three broken fingers and a degloving injury to the right palm.
An employee was attempting to put a gauze muzzle on a dog when the dog bit and lacerated the employee's right thumb, requiring hospitalization.
An employee was driving a four-wheeler when the vehicle struck a ditch, causing the employee to fall from the machine. The employee sustained rib and lung injuries.

An employee was rebuilding an intensifier on a high-pressure pump when the machine became energized by a remote operator. The piston on the pump extended on a hydraulic cylinder while the employee's hands were in the machine, pinching and amputating a finger between the cylinder and machine.

An employee was being trained on the operation of a 5-step depositor machine that fills muffin baking cups with batter. While the working motion of the machine was being demonstrated the employee contacted the slicing blade resulting in amputation of the pad of a finger. The machine was unguarded at the time.

On November 1, 2017, at approximately 10:00 a.m., an employee was helping to move a 30-gallon drum from a broken pallet to another pallet. His gloved hand was underneath the drum as he was transferring it. When it rolled onto the new pallet, his finger was pinched between the bottom of the drum and the pallet. His right index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was helping a patient use the toilet when the patient lost grip and started to fall. The injured employee grabbed the patient to keep her from falling. The force required to lift and hold the patient caused the employee's pre-existing hernia to be aggravated, resulting in hospitalization.

One employee was hospitalized for electrical burns to both hands and feet while working on downed power lines when a live power line fell onto the de-energized line. Two other employees were hospitalized for observation.
An employee was unloading doors from a truck when wood molding and building materials fell off the truck and struck his face, causing cuts and lacerations to the face and head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was thrown off a horse and sustained a broken clavicle, three broken ribs, and a possible punctured lung.
At 5:16 a.m., a convenience store manager was forced into the store at gunpoint, then shot, suffering a leg injury.

An employee fell five feet from either a ladder or the HVAC unit to the concrete floor below while performing plenum work. The employee suffered a fractured collarbone, two fractures to the lower spine, and head lacerations.
An employee was making a bracket on a power press when his left hand contacted the moving components in the press, partially amputating his index fingertip.

An employee was driving a golf cart with an attached trailer, delivering packages in a residential neighborhood. The golf cart flipped and the employee sustained a right eye injury and a scalp laceration.
An employee was operating a meat grinder. As the machine was in the process of stopping, the employee reached in to get a piece of meat and the grinder blade amputated the employee's index fingertip.
An employee was connecting a 2-inch pipe in a ceiling using hand tools and a drop light when he received an electric shock.

A range safety officer was observing a customer at a shooting range who was shooting a handgun when a hot shell casing flew down the customer's shirt, startling her. She stepped back from the firing line, turned towards the range safety officer, squeezed the trigger, and unintentionally shot the range safety officer in the leg. The right leg of the range safety officer was amputated.

An employee was on a welding table, cleaning the welding area of slag and debris. The employee fell from the table onto a trolley system 41 inches below, suffered two broken ribs and a lacerated liver.
While removing scaffold components, an employee tripped over a pallet. The employee's right hand got caught between bearings and the ring finger was broken. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a plastic component that was jammed in a de-energized machine. The employee placed their left hand on a metal slide, then used pliers with their right hand to pry the slide open. Upon applying significant force to the slide with the pliers, the jam broke free. The employee's left index fingertip was pinched and amputated between the slide and an adjacent metal surface.

An employee was attaching the dock plate to a truck in the loading area when the truck drove forward and the employee fell approximately 4 feet to the ground between the dock and the truck. The employee sustained a knee injury that required surgery.
An employee was stacking trusses and preparing to anchor them with a hammer and nail. When the employee struck the nail, it ricocheted and struck the employee's left eye.

An employee was removing tin from the roof of a residential structure when he slipped and fell, grabbed the edge of the roof, lost his grip, and then fell 12 feet to the ground below. He struck the back of his head on a wall when making contact with the ground, requiring hospitalization.

An employee came up behind a second employee, who was getting parts off a shelf, to put snow down his shirt. The second employee stood up and turned around, which knocked the first employee over. He fell against a tire and broke his right hip.
An employee was washing dishes in a catering facility when wet ceiling tiles fell and hit his head, causing head and neck contusions.
An employee tripped on a chair leg and fell fracturing her femur.
On May 1, 2020, an employee was stepping down from a 4-foot ladder when he lost his balance, jumped from the ladder and landed awkwardly on the ground, breaking his right leg. He was hospitalized.

An employee was working at the laydown yard moving windmill components. As the employee was stepping from atop one windmill machine head to another adjacent windmill machine head, she slipped and fell 15 feet to the ground below. The employee suffered a compression fracture of the L1 vertebra, a broken pelvis and a broken right ankle.
On Sunday, 2/15/15, an employee was walking outside to the bag house area when he slipped on ice and rolled his ankle. The employee required ankle surgery.
An employee fell approximately seven feet off a ladder and broke both wrists.
An employee was turning on the switch to a scrubber fan pump when the fan pump's pipe burst, causing the chemical inside the pipe to splash on and burn the employee's right arm.
An employee was installing a fastener to a mold when a support plate slipped and the mold fell from a hoist onto the employee's hand, resulting in a crush injury of the right hand fingers.

An employee was helping a resident shower when the resident dropped a tissue. As the employee bent over to pick the tissue up, the employee suffered back pain due to two herniated discs, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was driving a stand-up counterbalance forklift and making a U-turn in the warehouse. The lift struck a rack crushing his left foot. He was taken to the hospital and had a partial amputation of one toe.
An employee was operating a machine when it pulled in his hand. His index and middle fingertips were amputated.
An employee became ill after repairing a gas valve in an excavation.

Two employees were working on a tooling cross bar section. One employee had his right hand on top of a pneumatically controlled front tilt head. The tilt head actuated and pinched the tip of his right ring finger resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

An employee drove up in his truck to access a standpipe by the road. He got out of the truck and began lowering an electronic probe down on a reel and cable to measure the depth to water. The truck then moved and pinned/crushed his leg between the bumper and the standpipe. He was hospitalized.
An employee was repairing a mixer. A belt caught his left index finger and pulled it through a pulley. The index fingertip was amputated and his middle finger was split open.

An employee was cleaning out a box truck. While getting out of the back of the truck, he missed the first step, causing him to fall from the truck to the ground. He sustained a left leg fracture that required surgery.

An employee was responding to a machine which was not functioning. The employee pulled the drive belt to move the mechanism and the equipment started, pinching and amputating the employee's right thumb between the belt and pulley.

An employee was using a circular saw to cut wood for a wooden deck. As the employee was notching the back side of a piece of composite, it slipped, and the saw amputated his left ring and little fingers.
A maintenance employee was walking between buildings during his shift when he tripped on the curb and fell, breaking his upper left leg.
The employee was troubleshooting a piece of equipment. The cylinder closed and amputated his fingertip.
An employee attempting to remove plastic from under a conveyor injured his right hand and sustained an amputation to his right pinky. The conveyor was in operation at the time.
While exiting a tugger, an employee did not clear the loader track and tripped over it, breaking the right ankle.
An employee was attempting to restrain an aggressive student when he fell backwards and struck his head on the floor. The employee was hospitalized for a concussion.
An employee was operating a pallet jack and caught his right foot between the pallet jack and a storage rack.
Employee was lifting pipes when the pipes slipped and fell onto the employee's fingers resulting in medical amputation.
An employee was operating an ATV to move base plates on a roof when the throttle became stuck and he lost control, falling off the roof to the ground and breaking ribs.

An employee was on a ramp with a dolly when the dolly moved away from him and he fell down. His right hand was then caught between the dolly and the ramp, amputating his middle fingertip with no bone loss.
An employee was sitting on a dock when he dismounted the dock and landed awkwardly on his left ankle, breaking it.
While an employee was repairing/moving an electric powered pallet jack, the jack backed over his foot, lacerating and breaking bones in his right foot.
An employee suffered a right finger amputation while attempting to remove food products from the jammed motor blades of a vacuum tortilla oven.

An employee was using a 6-foot ladder to retrieve plant material. He fell off the ladder while standing on the third rung from the top and landed on the ground. The employee sustained a broken collarbone, broken rib, and a bruised lung.

On October 8, 2015, at approximately 12:45pm, an employee was operating an ATV when it began to slide on gravel. The ATV went over an embankment and rolled approximately 100 feet. The employee fell out of the ATV and suffered a fracture to his right ankle.
An employee was cleaning dough from the sheeter when their right hand was caught between the rollers. Their hand and fingers were crushed.

An employee was changing a fuse in a 440v electric panel when the fuse engaged, causing an arc flash that shorted out the panel and sent out a ball of fire. The employee received first and second degree burns on his face and hands. The employee was wearing safety glasses at the time of the incident.
An employee fell on top of another employee as he was setting a form wall. The employee on the ground suffered a broken hip and shattered ankle.
An employee suffered a finger amputation while operating a drill.

An employee was injured while walking through a non-tempered, automatic glass entrance door. The employee suffered cuts to the left leg, face, and right hand and required surgery to repair a leg muscle.

An employee was cutting a branch on a downed power line when tension in the power line released, causing it to snap up and strike the employee in the chest and neck area. The employee suffered internal chest and throat trauma.

On February 25, 2021, an employee was working on a 5 ft. scaffold applying a drywall finishing compound to the wall. The employee lost his balance and fell off the scaffold, resulting in a laceration and tissue damage to the right upper arm.
An employee was in the pig pen when the animals started fighting. One pig was on top of another when it rolled off and onto the employee's right ankle fracturing it.
An employee was moving a safe on a wheeled dolly when the wheel of the dolly ran over imperfections in the floor. The safe then tipped off the dolly and onto the employee's leg, breaking it.

Employee was wiping off the plate while the machine was running. The rag got caught in the machine pulling the employee's hand into the machine and catching it between the print cylinder and the anologix cylinder. The right 4th and 5th fingertips were amputated.
An employee was riding on a trash truck. When he jumped off the truck, he struck his head on the pavement and suffered a head injury.

An employee was cutting grass using a zero-turn lawn mower. The lawn mower frame snagged a power pole brace wire and pulled down the energized power pole. The employee sustained electrical burns to his left arm and left lower leg.

Employee was elevated approximately 12 ft. on a Crown High Level Order Picker removing items from a shelf when she stepped backwards and fell to the concrete surface below. Employee was donned in a harness, but did not have it attached and secured. Employee sustained a compound fracture to her right ankle and a cracked heel.
An employee was changing blades on a mower when their glove became caught in the shaft. The impact wrench then amputated the employee's left thumb.
An employee was holding a piece of wood to help another employee cut the wood with a circular saw when the sawblade amputated the employee's index finger and lacerated the middle and ring fingers.
An employee was installing decking on a new construction building. He walked towards the edge of the deck without being tied off and fell approximately 30 feet through an opening.
An employee was reading gas meters when a ram attacked him. The ram struck his lower left leg from behind, resulting in a fractured tibia that required hospitalization and surgery.

On December 22, 2021, an employee was walking from a bundler to a wrapper machine when she tripped on an ergonomic mat and fell to the concrete floor. She suffered a broken left arm and a dislocated left elbow and was hospitalized.

An employee was standing about 18 feet away from a 4-inch hose monitoring a pigging operation. The pig became stuck in the hose, causing pressure to build up; the hose whipped and struck the employee in the right upper arm, breaking his humerus.
An employee suffered an inguinal hernia requiring surgical repair after tightening a bolt with a small wrench.
An employee tripped over a pallet and fell resulting in a broken leg.
While lifting a crate, an employee suffered a compression fracture to the lower back, requiring hospitalization.
An employee fell or jumped off a truck at the loading dock and broke the left leg.
A temporary employee was shot in the stomach and left elbow by another temporary employee. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was cleaning and setting up an auger for product change and suffered a partial amputation of their right index finger.

An employee was walking on a catwalk to inspect the current job progress. While inspecting bolts, the employee fell 20 to 25 feet through the grating into a 2-feet-deep pool of water. The employee sustained rib and vertebrae fractures, a heel fracture, and a punctured buttock.
An employee was operating the rebar bending machine and amputated his left index fingertip.

On May 29, 2023, an employee was working on an ammonia compressor thermal siphon. When relieving the pressure, it released an ammonia cloud. The employee was hospitalized for breathing and swallowing difficulties as well as eye blurriness.

An employee was operating a jointer to make parts for two window sills just prior to glue up. The employee's glove came into contact with the jointer spindle, pulling his left hand in. Three left-hand fingers were amputated.
An employee was pushing a tote while restocking the aisle. She tripped over the tote and fell. She was admitted to the hospital for a fractured right hip.

An employee working as a framer was putting hardware on the bottom of an exterior wall on the right side of the house. He was standing on the completed deck floor of the second story when he fell to the dirt ground. The employee sustained a spinal cord injury resulting in paralysis from the chest down.
On or about February 29, 2016, an employee received a partial index finger amputation while working on the Magic Box A conveyor belt on the 500 Line in the Bindery Department.

An employee was in the bucket of a truck boom in the middle of three lateral tap lines running across the road. The employee used a bucket stick to de-energize the last tap line. The employee then swung the bucket back to where the truck was positioned, which placed the boom above the neutral system and de-energized wire, and where a cut-out was located above the neutral system. The employee's left shoulder contacted the top side of the cut-out and the employee suffered three electrical shocks, resulting in burns to neck, back, and chest. The employee's left arm was medically amputated up to the neck area, and their right arm was amputated below the elbow.
An employee was taking merchandise from the backroom to the sales floor. As he was lifting a car jack off a pallet, he heard a pop. He was hospitalized with a back injury.
The employee was doing a quality line check in the hot fill area. As she turned around, she tripped over the water hose, fell, and sustained a comminuted fracture to her left elbow.
An employee was bending down to get something from a bottom counter when the employee's eye hit a metal bag holder, causing an eye injury.

An employee was operating an electric forklift when it struck a pile of cardboard. The employee jumped off the forklift, which ran over the employee's left ankle. The employee sustained an injury to the ankle that required surgery, as well as a potential right wrist fracture.

An employee was working with another crane operator to move a crane. The employee had taken in the outriggers on his side and was moving one of the pads to a designated spot on the crane. He was walking around to the other side of the crane where the other operator was still putting the outriggers up. He slipped in the muddy conditions and put his left hand out to catch himself. His hand landed on the outrigger being brought in, crushing his ring and middle finger resulting in the amputation of both fingers.
An employee was laying down a power swivel when the swivel fell and fractured the employee's tibia and fibula.
An employee was using a band saw to cut a carbon brush when the saw amputated the employee's fingertip.

On February 15, 2022, an employee was adjusting storage racks from a scissor lift when the scissor lift battery died. The employee then climbed onto a steel rack and fell approximately 6 feet from the rack to the concrete floor below. The employee sustained fractures to his leg requiring surgery.

An employee was cleaning a railcar that was previously carrying phenol material when the employee noticed a valve in the railcar was clogged. The employee applied steam to the clog for 20 minutes to melt the material. Once complete, the employee opened the valve, which had built pressure, forcing the phenol and steam out of the pipe and onto the employee's face and neck. The employee suffered first degree burns to the face and neck and was hospitalized.
An employee was bending over to cut a box open when she felt severe pain in her back. She was hospitalized with a protruding disc in her neck and multiple upper back spasms.
An employee was reversing a mower when his right middle fingertip was pinched/amputated between the roll bar and a retention wire on a utility pole.
An employee was stripping a concrete form in a building basement when he lost his balance and fell approximately 4 feet onto a concrete slab. He was hospitalized with a concussion.

During their work shift, three employees were involved in horseplay that progressed into an altercation. One employee threw a pair of scissors at another employee, puncturing his arm and causing vascular and muscular damage. The injured employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

While on an aerial lift, an employee was removing a tree top using a chain saw when the tree top fell backwards and struck the employee. The force of the contact drove the employee's face into the lip of the aerial lift's bucket. The employee suffered a broken nose and several facial fractures.
An employee had just repaired the breader machine. As the employee reached into the machine to retrieve a tool his thumb was caught between the belt and auger and amputated.
An employee was driving a tanker uphill when the truck started rolling back down the hill and jack-knifed. The tanker rolled over, and the employee suffered a concussion and internal injuries.

An employee was mowing the grass when the mower slid into a drainage ditch and landed on top of them. The employee suffered amputated fingers on the right hand (3rd, 4th, 5th fingers) and a portion of the palm, leading to hospitalization and surgery.

An employee's right middle and ring fingers were caught between two pieces of metal that are parts of an automated rivet inserter. The two pieces of metal pressed together, partially severing her middle finger.

An employee was hooking a fifth-wheel dolly to the connector on a 28-foot trailer to create a tandem set of 28-foot trailers. The dolly moved in a pothole or divot on the ground and the employee's left hand was crushed between the dolly hitch and the connector, resulting in a left hand fracture.
An employee was working on the muller putting parts on it. The employee reached up on an I-beam to move himself and when he stepped back down his knee twisted and his femur was fractured.
An employee standing on a scaffold was helping to guide a load onto the roof. The back of his left hand was cut when it contacted the edge of the building's tin roof.
An employee tripped on concrete while exiting a parking structure. She suffered a broken left hip.
While coming down from a truck bed, an employee suffered a broken right ankle.
An employee was on the lift of a delivery truck. The employee's foot was caught between the ramp and the lift gate while the lift was operated. The employee's big toe was crushed.

The injured employee was standing next to a step ladder. Employee 2 was on the ladder when he lost balance and fell on top of the injured employee. The injured employee sustained injuries to the neck and shoulder and possibly to the head.
An employee was using a saw to cut meat when his right index finger contacted the blade and was amputated to the middle digit.

Employee had just finished unloading a truck into the paving machine. He had his hand on the gate of the truck. The truck operator latched the gate from the cab, crushing the pinky finger on the employee's right hand.
An employee was assisting in cleaning out the baghouse in the spray dryer room when the blades of the rotary valve amputated four fingers on their right hand.

An employee was clearing a clogged dust collector pipe. The employee was standing on a home-made platform that had been elevated approximately 10 feet in the air by a forklift. The platform measured approximately 12-feet long by 42-inches wide. The employee stepped off to the side of the platform where the platform was not supported by the forks, and the platform tipped from the forks. The employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground below. The employee sustained nine broken ribs and a punctured lung.

A commercial diver was preparing to get into the water to take measurements. Upon jumping in, the employee was bitten by an eight-to-twelve-foot bull shark, resulting in severed muscles and arteries to his left calf. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was operating a slitter machine. After threading the machine and starting the rewind process, the employee used his knife to remove a piece of tape that had gotten onto the surface of the metal. His knife was pulled into the machine, causing an amputation to the employee's right index finger below the fingernail.
An I-beam support fell from the top of a scale, striking an employee and fracturing bones in the employee's left leg.

An employee was using a pry bar to free metal trim scrap that had become lodged at the exit of a slitter. The weight of the 700-pound scrap caused the pry bar to strike and crush the employee's right thumb. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a paper jam on a machine and amputated two fingers.
An employee was attacked by a resident, suffering head injuries that required hospitalization.
An employee was performing roofing work from inside a man-made box attached to a forklift and fell 20 feet to the lower level.
A tree was cut down and fell on an employee, causing a back injury.
An employee was cleaning an auger on a production line. He suffered a finger amputation when he reached into the 8-inch auger, which came down on his finger.
An employee was walking from his car to the nursery entrance and was bitten by a stray dog resulting in the loss of a thumb tip.

Employees were rigging down. The injured employee was hooking up a flow line to a manifold. When he stepped back, he fell through a gap in the floor of the shaker, landing on his head on the ground about 12 feet below. He suffered multiple skull fractures and bleeding on the brain and was hospitalized.
An employee was riding a horse in a cattle pen when the horse bucked. He was thrown off the horse and hit the back of his head. He was hospitalized.
An employee was reversing a stand-up forklift when the employee collided with another reversing forklift, breaking the left forearm and requiring surgery.
